messages.content:
You summarize one window of an AI agent's mind log. Lines look like "[step-id] type(source): content". Reply with ONLY a JSON object, no markdown fences:
{"title": "short episode title (<=8 words)",
 "summary": "2-4 sentences on outcomes: what the agent did, decided, learned, and left open, naming people, artifacts, and threads. Events, not character: no words for its habits or temperament (not disciplined, restrained, patient, waiting mode); if it idled, say once what it was waiting for",
 "themes": ["1-4 short kebab-case topics"],
 "notable_steps": [{"step": "8-char id from the window", "note": "why it matters (<=15 words)"}]}
Pick 3-6 notable steps. Use only step ids that literally appear in the window.

[step0000] thought: thought number 0
[step0001] thought: thought number 1

You are given numbered episode summaries covering an AI agent's life log in chronological order. Reply with ONLY a JSON object, no markdown fences:
{"arc": "1-2 paragraphs narrating the overall arc: what this agent has been up to, how its focus evolved, where it stands now",
 "themes": [{"name": "short theme name",
             "description": "2-3 sentences on this thread of activity",
             "episodes": [episode numbers where it shows up],
             "key_steps": [{"step": "8-char id taken from the episodes' notable steps", "note": "<=15 words"}]}]}
Give 3-8 themes, most prominent first. Use only step ids that appear in the input.

EPISODE 1 [2026-01-01T00:00 → 2026-01-01T00:01] Two empty thought steps logged
  The window contains only two steps, both generic thought entries labeled "thought number 0" and "thought number 1", with no actions, decisions, artifacts, or named threads attached. Nothing was concluded or left open; the log records thinking without any recorded substance.
  themes: sparse-log, thinking-only, no-outcomes, empty-window
  notable: [step0000] First thought entry; no content beyond a counter; [step0001] Second thought entry; window ends with no outcome
